reason: What I've got works well enough, and I don't put the business on software nobody I know has used. No other operator at the association can vouch for it yet, and I'm not going to be the guinea pig in the middle of excursion and end-of-year season.
objection: Brand new company with zero customers. If it falls over on a Friday with twenty coaches out, or they fold in a year, I'm the one cleaning it up. The money-back offer and the Excel export don't fix a messed-up run sheet on the day.
would_change_my_mind: A coach operator I trust, running a fleet my size, telling me they've used it through a busy season and it held up, especially the double-booking blocks and the accreditation records.
